analysis.reasonEn: The previous 4 consecutive trading days maintained a buy signal. RSI has settled in the neutral zone, and MACD histogram shows improvement. Continued recovery of the 5-day low strengthens the Higher Low pattern. The current price of $334.81 is above the SMA20 of $329.86, trading sideways near the Bollinger Band middle line. The uptrend remains intact, but the price is 18.7% below the 52-week high, requiring confirmation of further upward momentum. Therefore, a wait-and-see approach is warranted.
analysis.narrative:

· 현재가($334.81) vs SMA5/20/50($335.21/$329.86/$313.26): 단기 하회, 중기 상회, 중장기 상회
· SMA100/200($262.97/$223.46) 대비 위치: 중장기 추세 강도 강세
· 52주 위치(81.3%) + 현 가격대 역사적 고점 대비 눌림 구간
[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (50.5 → 54.5): 중립 구간 안착, 과매도 탈출 후 회복세
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-2.2222 → -0.9252): 개선 중, 약세 수렴 구간 탈출 시도
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (중단 $329.86): 중단 근처 횡보, 밴드폭 12.44%로 변동성 보통 수준
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($303.89): 20일 저가 및 피벗 S1 기반
· 스윙 저항선 ($341.95): 5일 고가 및 피벗 PP 기반, 돌파 시 상승 탄력 기대
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (Higher Low): 5일 저가 회복으로 추세 강화 신호
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (1.01배): 정상 수준, 움직임 신뢰도 보통
· 현 구간 진단 (상승추세): 4거래일 연속 매수 판독 유지했으나, 52주 고가 대비 눌림으로 추가 상승 모멘텀 확인 필요. 따라서 관망.
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($334.81) vs SMA5/20/50($335.21/$329.86/$313.26): below short-term, above mid-term, above long-term
· Position vs SMA100/200($262.97/$223.46): strong mid-to-long term uptrend
· 52-week Position (81.3%) + current price range is a pullback from historical highs
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (50.5 → 54.5): holding neutral, recovering after exiting oversold
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-2.2222 → -0.9252): improving, attempting to exit weak convergence zone
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Line $329.86): trading sideways near the middle line, band width at 12.44% indicates moderate volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($303.89): based on 20-day low and Pivot S1
· Swing Resistance ($341.95): based on 5-day high and Pivot PP, upward momentum expected on breakout
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low): recovery of 5-day low signals strengthening trend
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.01x): normal level, moderate confidence in price movement
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Uptrend): buy signal maintained for 4 consecutive sessions, but pullback from 52-week high requires confirmation of further upward momentum. Therefore, wait-and-see.
